0022600174.text: The Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 3-2 on the road, riding a one-game win streak) visit the Washington Wizards (4-3, 2-1 at home, on a two-game win streak), with Atlanta 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back of Washington, which leads the division. For Atlanta, Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out, and Jalen Johnson (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. For Washington, Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve) are out, and Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but Atlanta won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 126-96 win in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
